body.name: Boundary-spliced active-face multiplier handle
body.construction: For fixed finite \((\mathcal E,T)\), \(\alpha_{\rm conf}\), and \(\bar\rho>0\), use the shared multiplier process for all faces, a self-normalized estimated near-active set for the max/min directional derivative, and the Hoeffding endpoint rectangle as the splice on variance-degenerate faces, returning \(\mathcal C^G_n\).
